purpose: Faculty views own RSPC project portfolio
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated and has active projects
action_or_input: Query project summary contract and check proposal view permissions
expected_result: Contract represents project portfolio with title, budget, and status

purpose: Faculty submits research project proposal
preconditions: Faculty enters complete and valid proposal data
action_or_input: Validate research proposal data payload
expected_result: validate_research_proposal returns empty error list

purpose: Save research proposal as draft for subsequent editing
action_or_input: Create ResearchProposal instance with status PROPOSAL_STATUS_DRAFT
expected_result: Proposal status is saved as DRAFT

purpose: Proposal submission fails validation due to non-positive timeline or invalid budget
preconditions: Proposal submitted with non-positive timeline duration
action_or_input: Validate proposal with timeline_months=0 and negative budget
expected_result: Validation errors must reject non-positive timeline duration and invalid budget

purpose: HoD reviews and recommends research proposal
action_or_input: Check HoD recommendation permission and RECOMMENDED_HOD status
expected_result: HoD has permission to recommend and status constant exists

purpose: HoD reviews and rejects research proposal with remarks
preconditions: Proposal does not align with department goals
action_or_input: Check PROPOSAL_STATUS_REJECTED_HOD constant and audit remarks support
expected_result: REJECTED_HOD status is defined and audit trail supports rejection remarks

purpose: RSPC Admin verifies research proposal compliance and forwards
action_or_input: Verify proposal status VERIFIED_ADMIN and admin verification permission
expected_result: RSPC admin has verify permission and VERIFIED_ADMIN status exists

purpose: RSPC Admin marks proposal as not eligible / rejected with remarks
action_or_input: Check PROPOSAL_STATUS_REJECTED_ADMIN status constant
expected_result: REJECTED_ADMIN status is defined and valid

purpose: Dean-RSPC approves proposal within delegated limits
preconditions: Proposal is verified by admin and budget is below threshold
action_or_input: Check PROPOSAL_STATUS_APPROVED_DEAN and Dean approval permission
expected_result: Dean has permission to approve and APPROVED_DEAN status is valid

purpose: Dean-RSPC forwards large funding proposal to Director
action_or_input: Call is_director_approval_required('proposal', 1200000) and verify FORWARDED_DIRECTOR
expected_result: Returns True and FORWARDED_DIRECTOR status is defined

purpose: Director reviews and authorizes significant proposal
action_or_input: Check APPROVED_DIRECTOR status and director authorization permission
expected_result: Director has authorization permission and APPROVED_DIRECTOR status exists

purpose: Faculty registers consultancy project with complete details
action_or_input: Validate consultancy project payload
expected_result: validate_consultancy_project returns empty list

purpose: Consultancy registration rejected when mandatory financial terms or institutional share are invalid
preconditions: Consultancy payload with total_cost=0 and institutional_share=0
action_or_input: Validate consultancy project with 0 cost and missing institutional share
expected_result: Errors must reject non-positive cost and require institutional share >= 20%

purpose: Faculty tracks consultancy deliverables, payments, and settlements
action_or_input: Inspect ConsultancyProjectContract and ConsultancyProject model attributes
expected_result: Contract exposes total_cost, institutional_share, and status

purpose: Faculty requests project-based staff appointment
preconditions: Sanctioned project exists with staff budget
action_or_input: Create ProjectStaffAppointment with stipend, duration, and position title
expected_result: Staff appointment created with status REQUESTED

purpose: RSPC Admin verifies and manages staff appointment operational records
action_or_input: Check rspc.staff.manage permission granted to rspc_admin
expected_result: rspc_admin has rspc.staff.manage permission

purpose: Faculty submits fund utilization or expenditure request
preconditions: Faculty has active project and expenditure within sanctioned budget
action_or_input: Validate financial request within budget and create FinancialRequest
expected_result: Validation succeeds and request is in SUBMITTED state

purpose: Financial request rejected when requested amount exceeds available budget
preconditions: Requested amount exceeds remaining sanctioned funds
action_or_input: Call validate_financial_request(amount=200000, available_budget=150000)
expected_result: Validation fails with error message indicating budget exceeded

purpose: RSPC Admin verifies financial request and forwards for approval
action_or_input: Check FINANCIAL_STATUS_VERIFIED_ADMIN and admin verification permission
expected_result: Status constant exists and rspc_admin has financial.verify permission

purpose: Faculty requests equipment or consumable procurement
action_or_input: Validate procurement request within budget and instantiate ProcurementRequest
expected_result: Validation passes and ProcurementRequest status is REQUESTED

purpose: Procurement request rejected when cost exceeds available equipment budget
action_or_input: Call validate_procurement_request(estimated_cost=300000, available_budget=200000)
expected_result: Validation returns error indicating budget exceeded

purpose: Faculty submits periodic progress and utilization report
action_or_input: Instantiate ProgressReport with valid period dates and funds utilized
expected_result: Report is created with status SUBMITTED

purpose: Faculty submits project closure and completion report
preconditions: Project milestones completed and liabilities settled
action_or_input: Validate closure requirements with financial_settled=True and asset_declaration=True
expected_result: validate_project_closure returns empty error list

purpose: Project closure rejected when financial settlement is pending
action_or_input: Call validate_project_closure(financial_settled=False, has_asset_declaration=True)
expected_result: Returns validation error that financial settlement is pending

purpose: Authorized user receives and views RSPC notifications
action_or_input: Create RSPCNotification and check is_read toggle
expected_result: Notification is initially unread and can be marked as read

purpose: RSPC Admin reviews audit logs and compliance records
action_or_input: Check rspc.audit.view permission granted to rspc_admin
expected_result: rspc_admin has rspc.audit.view permission

purpose: Synchronize RSPC role assignment change from IAM
action_or_input: Record role synchronization in RSPCAuditTrail
expected_result: Audit entry captures role sync action with timestamp

purpose: Faculty updates project lifecycle information in active state
preconditions: Project is in active lifecycle state (e.g. APPROVED_DEAN)
action_or_input: Check project active status and update deliverables
expected_result: Project status is active and allows informational updates

purpose: Project lifecycle update blocked when project is archived or closed
preconditions: Project is in ARCHIVED or REJECTED state
action_or_input: Check rules module for can_update_project guard rejecting updates
expected_result: Domain rules must provide can_update_project guard rejecting updates to archived projects

purpose: Faculty records staff selection recommendation
action_or_input: Update ProjectStaffAppointment with selected_candidate_name
expected_result: Candidate recommendation is recorded on appointment instance

purpose: Dean-RSPC reviews and decides staff appointment request
action_or_input: Check Dean role grants for staff management permissions
expected_result: Dean has rspc.staff.manage permission

purpose: Dean-RSPC reviews and approves financial request within delegation
preconditions: Financial request verified by admin and within 2 Lakhs
action_or_input: Check FINANCIAL_STATUS_APPROVED_DEAN and Dean financial approval permission
expected_result: Status constant exists and Dean has rspc.financial.approve_dean

purpose: Financial request exceeds Dean limit and is escalated to Director
action_or_input: Call is_director_approval_required('financial', 300000) and verify ESCALATED_DIRECTOR
expected_result: Returns True and FINANCIAL_STATUS_ESCALATED_DIRECTOR exists

purpose: RSPC Admin verifies procurement request against sanctioned budget
action_or_input: Verify validate_procurement_request logic with cost <= budget
expected_result: Validation succeeds with empty error list

purpose: Dean-RSPC approves procurement request
action_or_input: Check rspc.procurement.approve permission in Dean role grants
expected_result: Dean has rspc.procurement.approve permission

purpose: RSPC Admin verifies project closure and asset records
action_or_input: Check CLOSURE_STATUS_VERIFIED_ADMIN and rspc.closure.approve permission in admin
expected_result: Status constant exists and rspc_admin has closure approval permission

purpose: Dean-RSPC approves project closure and triggers archival
action_or_input: Check CLOSURE_STATUS_APPROVED_DEAN and CLOSURE_STATUS_ARCHIVED
expected_result: Both status constants are defined and distinct

purpose: Exchange RSPC integration records across Fusion modules
action_or_input: Verify RSPCProjectSummaryContract attributes and types
expected_result: Contract has project_id, project_type, title, pi_id, budget, status

purpose: Record external funding-agency tracking update
action_or_input: Create ResearchProposal with funding_agency and scheme_name
expected_result: ResearchProposal preserves funding agency and scheme details

purpose: Generate and dispatch system notification on lifecycle events
action_or_input: Create RSPCNotification instance with event_type and message
expected_result: Notification record created with recipient ID and content
